asideText: Amounts are converted in your browser. Only the exchange-rate lookup contacts the public Frankfurter rates API — your amounts are never uploaded or stored.

faq.a: Live rates come from the Frankfurter API (European Central Bank reference rates), fetched fresh each time you change a currency. If the rate service cannot be reached, the tool falls back to last-known rates recorded 2026-11-03 and clearly labels them as possibly outdated.
faq.q: Where do the exchange rates come from?

faq.a: Yes — USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, INR, PKR, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, AED, SAR, HKD, SGD, NZD, SEK, NOK, DKK, MXN, BRL, ZAR, KRW, TRY and THB. Rates for PKR, AED and SAR are not published by the Frankfurter source, so those use last-known rates recorded 2026-11-03 and are always labelled as approximate.

whenNotToUse: Rates are reference rates for planning — banks and money-transfer services add their own spread and fees, so the amount you actually receive will differ.
Never treat a fallback (possibly outdated) rate as a live quote for a real payment or trade — check a live source first when the warning is shown.
